title: Consistent literal redaction in command previews and execution

requirements.statement: Preview and execution sanitize the same literal values consistently without leaking the suffix of an overlapping configured literal.

sources.reference: src/verify.mjs uses sequential replacement while src/runner.mjs uses longest-first one-pass replacement; regression reproduced with synthetic alpha/alpha-beta.

acceptance.statement: Both orders of alpha and alpha-beta fully replace the argv value alpha-beta, and preview argv equals the recorded execution argv.
A configured REDACTED literal does not reprocess a generated [REDACTED] marker.
Literal regex metacharacters are escaped and existing bounded streaming redaction behavior remains valid.

decisions.summary: Extract the existing runner one-pass literal redactor for shared preview/execution use.

tasks.summary: Share literal redaction between preview and runner and add regressions.

tests.summary: CLI preview/execution overlap and replacement-marker regression tests.
Shared redactor metacharacter/limit tests and existing streaming runner tests.
